node.title: Statement U and the far-CA exact value at the crossing offset
node.closure: one-sentence reduction of the far-CA residual, with an exact-value consequence
node.statement: STATEMENT U: at razor shape (n = 2^41, k = R = 2^40, rho = 2^34, a = k + 2^34, r = n - a = 63*rho), every bad slope of a column-far pencil admits a locator inside W = S_1 u S_2. U implies B_ca^far(k + 2^34) = r + 1 = 1082331758593 = 2^39.977280 exactly, the floor being the banked LB1 construction and the cap the fibre pigeonhole T_fib <= floor(r/f) + 1 with f = |W| - r. In the decomposition T = T_fib + T_sym + T_rand, T_fib satisfies the PROVED bracket ceil((r+1)/d) <= T_fib <= floor(r/f)+1 with equality r+1 iff f = 1 and chi injective; U is exactly T_sym = T_rand = 0. U-sym is condition-killed at razor rho: an orbit-invariant locator carrier on a mu_M-invariant domain leaves ceil(rho/M) conditions on one unknown slope, so it needs M >= rho = 2^34, and at M = 2 the surplus is 2^33 - 1 = 8589934591 conditions (a rho-threshold, q-independent) -- modulo an unmeasured symmetric-T variant at rho = 3. U-rand is completely unpriced and is the open residual, so the statement as a whole is a TARGET and the exact value is conditional on U.
